feeds.title: IFA Blog » European Logistics
feeds.description: The IFA is a network of more than 50 independent, small, and medium-sized forwarders throughout Europe. We offer a Europe-wide classical groupage transport service. We are also your reliable partners for small shipments and complete loadings. Explore the European logistics blog that works as a guide for you giving information and tips for shipment all around Europe.

feeds.title: Fulfillment Europe Blog
feeds.description: Here at Fulfillment Europe, we are dealing with the distribution of goods under one roof -we store, pack and deliver your goods and parcels. Without your worries and cheaper. For all kinds of goods and sizes of packages or pallets.

feeds.title: JJX Logistics
feeds.description: JJX Logistics is the 'one-stop shop' for all your logistics requirements providing the total fulfillment solution to include warehousing and storage. Our services include same-day express transport throughout the UK and Europe, Groupage deliveries, ADR Transport, and Refrigerated transport to name a few. We also specialize in bonded storage and our warehousing capabilities allow us to provide fulfillment services to suit your needs.

feeds.title: Columbus Logistics Blog
feeds.description: Here at Columbus Logistics, our goal is to simplify a complicated process: we want to communicate and share information transparently. We have been active in the logistics sector since 1988. With three specialized divisions, over 180 professionals, 72,000 square meters of warehouses, and an evolved know-how.

feeds.title: Logistics Business
feeds.description: Logistics Business Magazine is the only pan-European journal for all aspects of logistics, supply chain, warehousing & materials handling. It covers software solutions, mobile computing, barcoding, RFID, labeling, warehousing, conveying, sortation, packaging systems, automation, robotics, and much more.

feeds.title: Logistics Manager
feeds.description: Logistics Manager is the leading monthly magazine for managers in charge of the supply chain of the UK's largest industrial, retail, and commercial organizations. Logistics Manager's editorial focuses on the core competencies essential to modern logistics and supply chain management. On this website, we publish daily news stories, case studies, opinions, and more related to temperature-controlled supplies.

feeds.title: Scallog Blog
feeds.description: Scallog has established itself for 10 years as a major player in this evolution. By equipping logistics warehouses with the best software and hardware technological advances, Scallog optimizes order preparation for e-commerce specialists and manufacturers. With great simplicity and speed of installation, with flexible deployment, Scallog supports its customers in automating their warehouses.

feeds.title: Warehouse & Logistics News
feeds.description: Warehouse & Logistics News is the UK's only fortnightly magazine for the warehousing, distribution, logistics, storage, and handling industry. We combine the best of printed and new media to get your message to the senior buyers and decision-makers in the warehousing and logistics industry.

feeds.title: First European Logistics
feeds.description: Established in 2009, First European Logistics Ltd is a trusted and leading European Freight Forwarder & Customs Broker. We are fully trained in customs processes and procedures. From creating EADs to deferring duty payments, we have you covered. You provide us with the information, we will handle all the relevant customs processes inhouse.

feeds.title: The European Logistics Hub
feeds.description: Welcome to The European Logistics Hub, your go-to resource for logistics news, tips, and insights in the EU and UK. Our blog covers a wide range of logistics-related topics, including road, rail, and sea transportation, as well as the latest trends and innovations in logistics technology. Join us as we explore the challenges and opportunities facing the logistics industry and provide valuable information to help businesses optimize their supply chain operations.

feeds.title: My Logistics Magazine
feeds.description: My Logistics Magazine is a magazine dedicated to providing comprehensive coverage of the intermodal logistics industry. We are a magazine produced with CARE (Commentary, Analysis, Reflection and Experience). Our readers value our content because it provides them with insight from some of the smartest minds in the business.

feeds.title: Amekar Logistics Blog
feeds.description: Amekar Logistics started with the purpose of providing a new generation of international logistics services. Amekar Logistics offers you worry-free, fully integrated global logistics solutions. Our goal is to streamline your supply chain operations by providing you with a one-stop shop for your business import and export needs.

feeds.title: Bisham Consulting Blog
feeds.description: We are Logistics and Supply Chain Consultants who have been in business for over 30 years. As a result, we have a very successful track record and a high rate of repeat business. We deliver commercial, practical, operationally proven results for our clients in the UK and Ireland, Pan-European, and around the World.

feeds.title: Euro Pool System Blog
feeds.description: Euro Pool System is the leading logistics provider of reusable packaging in the European fresh supply chain. With our reusable, folding trays, we not only optimize your supply chain but also build a sustainable future.

feeds.title: Trimble
feeds.description: Trimble Transport & Logistics offers innovative solutions for safe, cost-efficient, and sustainable transport. As an experienced partner, we help you with your logistics management and lift your transport company, large or small, to a higher level.
